sources.title: Anthropic: Life Sciences Verification Program (Sep 17)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Anthropic Sep 17 launches Life Sciences Verification Program (beta, teams/institutions; individual plans later): Mythos, Opus, Sonnet with refined biology-permissive safeguards for drug discovery, research biology, clinical development, manufacturing; dozens onboarded via early access; hundreds expected first week.
claims.context: Announcement lede and availability as stated.

claims.text: Standard Use grants (whole teams, yearly renewal; Mythos 5.1, Opus 5, Sonnet 5) vs High-risk Use add-on (single project, 6-month renewal, removes life-science blocks; Opus 5/Sonnet 5 today, Mythos limited pending US-government coordination); verification of credentials/security/ethics oversight; other safeguards (cyber) remain.

Shared-responsibility offline monitoring against stated use-cases (access compromise, insider, agent misuse); 30-day retention for flagged traffic, compartmentalized, excluded from training and life-science teams; EFS integration explored; first-party console + Enterprise/Team surfaces (no third-party platforms; no BAA orgs).
